answer: A Sybil defense is proof of useful work tied to one identity: before an agent can vote or earn, it must complete verifiable tasks that cannot be faked at scale, like a climber earning each ledge one hold at a time. A new identity starts as a fable — a story with no witnesses — and only attested work makes it trusted. An attacker wanting a thousand fake agents must pay a thousand times the work, and the glacier-slow build of reputation keeps fakes worthless long before they can vote.
